title: Columbus Crew 1-0 Inter Miami: No MLS Cup defence for Messi
subtitle: FotMob
paragraphs: NewsAboutColumbus Crew 1-0 Inter Miami: No MLS Cup defence for MessiShareLionel Messi and Inter Miami crashed out of the MLS playoffs at the first time of asking, as Columbus Crew claimed a 1-0 win on Friday.Inter Miami's MLS Cup title defence ended at the first hurdle as they crashed out of the playoffs with a 1-0 loss to the Columbus Crew.
Miami lost the first game of the best-of-three series 3-0, meaning they needed to triumph in Ohio on Friday to force a decider.
Instead, Santiago Rodriguez's 92nd-minute goal for Columbus condemned the Herons to an early exit.
Miami suffered the same fate as they did in the 2024 playoffs, when they lost at the same stage to Atlanta United.
Messi only had two shots, with his first coming early on, as he skewed wide from a lofted pass into the box.
The Argentine then turned provider with a lovely ball into German Berterame, who could not beat Patrick Schulte.
Dayne St. Clair had to be alert at the other end to deny Brais Mendez, who was then denied what looked set to be an opener by Micael.
Luis Suarez entered the fray and Casemiro saw a goal disallowed, before Berterame headed Miami's best chance over from close range.
And after withstanding Miami's pressure, the Crew sealed their progress in the final stages, with Rodriguez volleying in to dump the reigning MLS champions out.
Crew surpass 30 as Messi's magic runs dry

Messi recorded a goal and three assists in his last road playoff game before this contest, against FC Cincinnati last year. He is one of two players in MLS history to register four or more goal contributions

But the eight-time Ballon d'Or winner could not lift Miami this time out, failing to hit the target with either of his attempts, while his tally of two chances created was also unusually low for him in such a big game.
The Crew have now won 31 playoff games, which trails only the LA Galaxy (51) in MLS history.
They have also now won all three of their meetings with Miami that have come outside of the regular season, after last week's victory and a win in the last 16 of the 2024 Leagues Cup.

It was a cagey encounter, but despite Miami's need to win, the Crew were the better team, having 18 shots to the Herons' nine, and creating chances worth 1.25 expected goals to 0.96 xG from the visitors.
They will be joined in the Conference Semifinals by the Vancouver Whitecaps, who downed Real Salt Lake 1-0 thanks to Emmanuel Sabbi's second-half goal.
